children.approach: Meta-lemma: Karoubi/Cauchy completion of any category is a category (associative); Kar preserves+reflects associativity. So splitting idempotents can neither create nor measure non-associativity. Standard (Borceux I 6.5; nLab idempotent-completion).
Main PROVE hypothesis: magmoid non-associativity = failure of k to split in Kar(C).
children.reason: VACUOUS receptacle. k already splits (child k-is-split-idempotent), so Karoubi/Cauchy completion is a no-op on it and there is no splitting failure to carry the obstruction; reinforced by completion-preserves-associativity (a construction that preserves associativity cannot measure its failure). Well-posed but refuted on the merits -- NOT ill-posed, so the gate passes and the claim is decided negative.

children.approach: Prior (WAKE 2026-10-17): read k as a 2-cocycle in H^2.
children.reason: Receptacle does not exist: k is non-additive in the non-abelian [DM,DM], and the cocycle condition IS associativity (h2-weld-class-is-splitting-not-associativity N2), which the sesquilaw destroys. No cocycle without associativity. See questions/idempotent-defect-cohomological-reinterpretation.md (RESOLVED-negative).

children.approach: Positive localization: non-associativity = k is LEFT-absorptive (Lemma 3.5, k;n=n; left-bracket = normalize-at-end) but NOT right-absorptive. Hom-level model 𝒞=Kl(DM) with split idempotent e=(-);k on homs; associativity <=> k absorbed on right block. Reproduces Prop 4.9's three purity cases exactly (defect 1e-16) with correct negative controls.

FOURTH named map (PROVE 2026-10-19): is handedness (k left- not right-absorptive) an instance of / faithfully receivable by a Schoen (arXiv:2307.16552) or Tholen (1603.06251/1605.04489) lax distributive law? Null-prior: name the structure map (P monad, F bare functor, lambda:FP->PF) and check both variance assignments.
children.reason: Wrong locus / structurally adjacent. Lax-DL laxifies the COHERENCE CELLS of a distributive law (a fixed-direction order inequality on a single 2-cell, for ONE monad P); handedness is an asymmetry of the ARGUMENT SLOTS of the induced binary composition # (two monads, strict equalities). DECISIVE discriminator: both bracketings (f#g)#h, f#(g#h) land in Norm's NORMALIZED hom-set (mass 1), and distinct probability measures are order-INCOMPARABLE (elementary lemma), so the defect cannot be any fixed-direction lax <=. Variance analysis also fails: assignment alpha (P=M,F=D,lambda=n) puts the defect in D-multiplicativity = F-structure, invisible to Schoen; assignment beta (P=D,F=M) forces lambda=m (strict, no defect) and excludes n by variance. Tempting near-miss id<=k (normalization raises mass) is a genuine lax cell but not one of Schoen's (N,E1,E2) and not what handedness IS. Confirmed computationally: id<=k 0/20000 violations; bracketings distinct 8000/8000, <=-comparable 0/8000.

children.approach: CONSTRUCTIVE positive counterpart to the 4 refuted maps (PROVE 2026-10-19 #2): build the home of handedness at the correct (binary-operation) locus. Definition: a NORMALIZER on an associative category 𝒜 = idempotent hom-operator K with left-absorption (LA) K(K(x)·c)=K(x·c); normalized magmoid N_K has f#g:=K(f·g). Theorem A: (LA) ⟹ (f#g)#h=K(f·g·h) (left bracket normalizes once). Theorem B: given (LA), N_K associative ⟺ K two-sided (RA_#) K(f·K(g·h))=K(f·g·h) — so handedness=(LA)∧¬(RA_#) is a GENUINE non-vacuous obstruction (contrast Karoubi vacuous). Instance: Norm = (substochastic kernels, K=row-normalize); (LA) proved by hand (K(M)=D_M·M, positive-diagonal invariance K(P·M)=K(M)); (RA_#) fails on exact witness f=[2/3,1/3],g=[[2/3,1/3,0],[0,1/2,1/2]],h=[[1,0],[0,0],[0,1]]: (f#g)#h=[8/11,3/11]=K(fgh) but f#(g#h)=[2/3,1/3]. SHARP minimality (Prop 5.1): principal normalizer K(x)=κ·x by a fixed idempotent ELEMENT κ (κ²=κ) is ALWAYS associative (κg=g for g∈ImK) — a distinguished idempotent element CANNOT carry handedness; the home MUST be a genuine (non-linear) operator normalizer. Decisively closes the near-semiring temptation per null-prior (its one-sided absorbing zero is an element ⟹ associativity-preserving ⟹ wrong KIND of object). Triangulation now COMPLETE: 1 EXISTS + 3 REFUTED + 1 CONSTRUCTED.
(LA) ⟹ (f#g)#h = K((f#g)·h) = K(K(f·g)·h) =_{(LA), x=f·g} K(f·g·h). Uses only (LA) + associativity of 𝒜. Elementary, airtight.

Given (LA): N_K associative ⟺ (RA_#). (⇐) f#(g#h)=K(f·K(g·h))=_{RA_#}K(f·g·h)=(f#g)#h by Thm A. (⇒) associativity equates the two sides, which IS (RA_#) for f,g,h∈Im K. Handedness=(LA)∧¬(RA_#) non-vacuous. Elementary, airtight.

Lemma 4.1: row-normalization satisfies (LA). K(M)=D_M·M, D_M=diag(1/rowsum)>0; (i) K(P·M)=K(M) for positive diagonal P; (ii) K(x)·c=D_x·(x·c) by associativity; hence K(K(x)·c)=K(D_x·(x·c))=K(x·c). By hand, exact. Faithful to DLRS Norm via arXiv:2510.01131 Prop 4.6 (Kleisli presentation).

Proposition 5.1: K(x)=κ·x with κ²=κ ⟹ (LA) automatic AND N_K ALWAYS associative. Key: κg=g for g∈Im K, so the inner κ in f·κ·(g·h) is absorbed. Element-level idempotents are associativity-preserving ⟹ handedness is intrinsically operator-level (Tier-2). Corollary: Norm's K is non-linear (K(λM)=K(M)), hence not κ·(−); so Norm is genuine. Verified 0/3000 over random idempotents (both sides). This is the sharp minimality statement + the decisive null-prior kill of the near-semiring-element guess.
